title: 第381章 地府观影如懿传刀后革命7第380章 地府观影如懿传刀后革命6
content_zh:
看着乾隆凄惨的模样，心里怒火未消的胤俄又给了他一脚，骂道：“跟爷比尊贵？爷告诉你，别说是你们这对颠公颠婆，就是老爷子，他的血统也没爷纯粹，哼！”
一旁的太子见老对头面露挣扎的模样，就知道自己想要的东西稳了。
于是心情也好了点，勾唇一笑，打趣道：“胤俄，你可是大清的清纯子，其他人确实比不上你，尤其是某些长得丑、心思毒，还老不死的祸害。”
！！！
这话一出，朱厚照瞬间乐了，不怀好意的开口道：“哈哈哈，胤礽大兄弟，虽然你说的含蓄，但还不如直接报康麻子的名字呢，毕竟在场的众人里面，他应该是最丑的了。”
康熙本来打算装没听见，毕竟糟心的儿子也没指名道姓，但朱厚照挑破了一切，他要是好不作为，日后怎么出去见人、不、是鬼。
“保成，既然你和朕恩断义绝，那就不要总是言语挑衅，朕......”
“请称呼本官为赫舍里大人，你不配叫我名字。”
“你......”
胤俄拉着自家九哥，不确定的问道：“清纯子？九哥，二哥真的不是在骂我简单愚蠢吗？这称呼怎么听着那么怪？”
看着蠢弟弟清澈的大眼睛，胤禟麻了。
人家又没指名道姓，你上赶着捡骂，当真是‘清纯子’啊！
【海兰：你岂能对我姐姐动手？她是你庶母。】
【如懿：海兰，这是二阿哥对我尊贵身份的认可，尊贵的东西，自然只有尊贵的人才配试验，你绣娘出身，见识少，不懂也正常。】
【海兰：姐姐，我会好好学习，谢谢姐姐愿意教导我。】
！！！？？？
“不是，是我疯了还是这个世界疯了，挨打居然是身份尊贵的象征，那老头子岂不是要被打死？”
“哈哈哈，连疯子都能当你们爱新觉罗家的真爱，你们可真是不讲究啊！”
听着朱元璋的嘲笑声，皇太极几人气的满脸通红，骂道：“靠，这是哪个王八蛋造出来的世界，一点史书史料都不读的吗？我们爱新觉罗家虽然误了华夏，但你不能侮辱我们的智商和审美啊！”
指着水镜里的画面，朱棣冷哼道：“嗤，你是说花里胡哨的农家乐审美，还是‘一片一片又一片’的文采？这非同一般智商审美，你让人家编剧怎么写？人家也很为难的。”

......
无力反驳的努尔哈赤只能狠狠的瞪了罪魁祸首一眼，骂道：“回去老子再收拾你，四万首诗没一篇能看的，丢人现眼的玩意。”
乾隆：为什么受伤的总是我？我治国理政还是有功绩的啊！
“哈哈哈，乾小四，一路走好，好好享受老祖宗爱的鞋底子吧。”
惹不起老祖宗，乾隆却不怕朱厚照，于是回怼道：“我们爱新觉罗家都是文明人，才不会脱鞋揍人呢，哼！”
【如懿：弘历哥哥，我保护你。】
【弘历：选四岁的短命鬼承祜当阿玛，你也不嫌晦气。】
【清成祖永琏：那也比你这个卑躬屈膝的金高宗完颜构二代要强！】
！！！
随着水镜的画面落下，众人不约而同的后退两步，按他们对太子二哥、不、是赫舍里大人性子的了解，他的鞭子该出场了。
这个念头刚刚滑过心头，就听到了耳边清脆的声音。
“保成弟弟，给我揍他，敢骂我是短命鬼，我让他变成死鬼！”
听着自家亲哥哥的声音，胤礽掏出了自己的新武器，慢条斯理的说道：“这是我刚刚到手的散魂鞭，每一鞭都会散去你的功德，痛感直达灵魂，好好享受吧！”
说完之后，周遭响起了鞭子划破长空的声音、乾隆的惨叫声，以及承祜的拍手叫好声。
content_en:
Seeing Qianlong's miserable appearance, Yiner, who was still angry in his heart, kicked him again and cursed: "Compared with me? I tell you, let alone you two, even the old man, his bloodline is not as pure as me, hum!"
The prince on the side saw the struggling look on his old enemy's face and knew that what he wanted was secured.
Then he felt a little better. He raised his lips and smiled, jokingly saying: "Yin'er, you are an innocent son of the Qing Dynasty. Others are really not as good as you, especially some who are ugly, have vicious minds, and are still old and immortal."
! ! !
As soon as these words came out, Zhu Houzhao instantly became happy and said maliciously: "Hahaha, brother Yinreng, although you said it implicitly, it is better to just tell Kang Mazi's name directly. After all, he should be the ugliest among everyone present."
Kangxi originally planned to pretend not to hear, after all, his troubled son didn't name him, but Zhu Houzhao revealed everything. If he didn't do anything, how could he go out to see people, no, ghosts in the future.
"Baocheng, since you have severed all ties with me, don't always provoke me with words, I..."
"Please call me Lord Hesheli. You are not worthy of calling me by my name."
"You..."
Yiner pulled his ninth brother and asked uncertainly: "Qingzhunzi? Ninth brother, isn't the second brother really calling me simple and stupid? Why does this title sound so weird?"
Looking at the stupid brother's clear big eyes, Yinzhen felt numb.
They didn’t mention her by name, but you rushed to criticize her, you really are a ‘pure child’!
[Hailan: How can you do something to my sister? She is your concubine. 】
[Ruyi: Hailan, this is the second elder brother’s recognition of my noble status. Of course, only noble people are worthy of experimenting with noble things. You were born as an embroiderer and have little experience. It’s normal for you to not understand. 】
[Hailan: Sister, I will study hard. Thank you sister for being willing to teach me. 】
! ! ! ? ? ?
"No, am I crazy or the world is crazy? Being beaten is a symbol of status and dignity. Doesn't that mean the old man will be beaten to death?"
"Hahaha, even a madman can think that you love the Xinjieluo family's true love. You are really unscrupulous!"
Listening to Zhu Yuanzhang's ridicule, Huang Taiji's faces turned red with anger, and he cursed: "Damn, what bastard created this world without reading any historical records? Although our Aixinjueluo family missed China, you can't insult our IQ and aesthetics!"
Pointing to the scene in the water mirror, Zhu Di snorted coldly: "Hey, do you mean the gaudy farmhouse aesthetic, or the 'piece after piece' literary talent? This is an extraordinary intellectual aesthetic. How do you ask the screenwriter to write it? It will be very difficult for others."
...
Nurhaci, unable to refute, could only glare at the culprit and cursed: "I will deal with you when you get back. Not one of the 40,000 poems can be read. It's a shameful thing."
Qianlong: Why is it always me who gets hurt? I still have merit in governing the country!
"Hahaha, fuck my mistress, have a good journey, and enjoy the soles of your ancestors' favorite shoes."
He couldn't offend his ancestors, but Qianlong was not afraid of Zhu Houzhao, so he replied: "We Aixinjueluo family are civilized people, so we won't take off our shoes and beat people, huh!"
[Ruyi: Brother Hongli, I will protect you. 】
[Hongli: It’s not unlucky for you to choose Chenghu, a short-lived four-year-old ghost, to be your Arma. 】
[Yonglian, Chengzu of the Qing Dynasty: That is better than you, the groveling second generation of Jin Gaozong Wan Yangou! 】
! ! !
As the image of the water mirror fell, everyone took two steps back in unison. According to their understanding of the character of the prince's second brother, no, Mr. Hesheli, it was time for his whip to appear.
As soon as this thought passed through my mind, I heard a crisp sound in my ears.
"Brother Baocheng, beat him up. If you dare to call me a short-lived ghost, I will make him a dead ghost!"
Listening to his brother's voice, Yinreng took out his’s new weapon, he said slowly: "This is the soul-dispersing whip I just got. Every whip will scatter your merits, and the pain will go straight to your soul. Enjoy it!"
After he finished speaking, the sound of whips cutting through the sky, Qianlong's screams, and Chenghu's clapping could be heard all around.
